About this Role:
We are looking for a meticulous and driven member to join our finance team in Bangalore. The ideal candidate will be a Semi-Qualified Chartered Accountant with a strong background in professional services (CA firms) and a deep understanding of full-cycle accounting.
In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, managing Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP) reconciliations, and ensuring compliance with financial regulations.

lists.content:
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records, ensuring all transactions comply with accounting standards
  • Manage end-to-end Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable processes, including aging analysis and reconciliations
  • Perform monthly bank, vendor, and inter-company reconciliations to ensure data accuracy and integrity
  • Use ZOHO Books for day-to-day accounting, reporting, and process automation
  • Support GST, TDS, and other statutory compliance filings, and assist in year-end audit preparation with organized documentation
  • Prepare periodic financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet) and MIS reports for management review

• Semi-Qualified CA (Inter CA cleared)
  • 3–5 years of practical experience in bookkeeping and accounting
  • Prior exposure to CA firms or managing multiple client accounts/audit assignments is a strong plus
  • Hands-on experience with ZOHO Books or the ZOHO Finance Suite
  • Advanced Excel proficiency (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, financial modeling)
  • Strong understanding of AR/AP cycles, reconciliations, and statutory compliances (GST/TDS)

• Strong attention to detail with a high level of accuracy
  • Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage tight month-end timelines
  • Effective communication skills to coordinate with vendors and internal/external stakeholders

• Work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Gain exposure to diverse financial portfolios and real business impact.
  • Competitive compensation and accelerated career growth for ambitious finance talent.

About Fam
 
Fam (previously FamPay) is India's first payments app for everyone above 11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ youngest users in India to kickstart their financial journey early in their lives. Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder's Capital, and angels including Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.
 
Role Overview
 
We just don't collaborate, we partner with brands!
You'll be right in the middle of making those partnerships stronger, smarter, and more impactful. We are on a mission to build the most rewarding payments app for the next generation and your role will bring huge impact on the experience of 10M+ users on Fam’s platform.
If you love creating win-win collaborations, thrive in fast-paced environments, and know how to turn ideas into revenue — this one’s for you.
 
Must-Haves
3+ years of experience in Partnerships, Business Development, Strategic Alliances, or Revenue-focused roles.
Experience working with consumer brands, fintech, e-commerce companies, advertising agencies, or platform/marketplace ecosystems.
Strong understanding of two-sided marketplace dynamics and value propositions.
Demonstrated commercial acumen with the ability to identify, negotiate, and close partnership opportunities that drive revenue.
Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience collaborating across internal teams and external partners.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including creating partnership decks, drafting negotiation emails, and preparing internal alignment documents.
Strong negotiation and relationship-building abilities. 
Data-driven mindset with the ability to track partnership performance and identify growth opportunities.
Builder mentality — thrives in ambiguity and moves fast
Ability to manage multiple partnerships and projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Good to Haves
Experience working in high-growth startups or scaling businesses.
Experience with GTM planning, co-marketing initiatives, or strategic alliance programs.
Roles & Responsibilities
Own and nurture relationships with existing partners, ensuring regular engagement and a seamless partner experience.
Act as the primary point of contact for partner queries, follow-ups, and day-to-day communication.
Build strong rapport with partners and confidently drive conversations to identify opportunities for deeper collaboration.
Support commercial discussions, partnership renewals, and new partnership opportunities alongside internal stakeholders.
Create partnership presentations, proposals, meeting notes, and other communication materials as required.
Coordinate with internal teams such as Product, Marketing, Operations, and Finance to ensure smooth execution of partner initiatives.
Track partnership performance, maintain regular updates, and share key insights with the team.
Identify opportunities to strengthen existing partnerships through campaigns, activations, or cross-functional initiatives.
Maintain accurate partnership documentation and ensure timely follow-ups on ongoing discussions.
Represent the company professionally in partner meetings, networking events, and industry interactions.
Why Join Us
Build a category-defining brand for the next generation in India.
Work directly with founders and leadership in a high-visibility role with ownership from day one.
Own partnerships that directly drive business growth and revenue.
Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership culture where builders make an impact.
Work in an AI-native environment with access to the best AI tools to move faster and build smarter.

• Manage end-to-end monthly payroll processing on Keka, including inputs, computation, disbursement, and reconciliation with full accuracy and timely delivery.
• Administer the ESOP programme by maintaining grant registers on EquityList and Excel, coordinating exercise requests, and communicating vesting milestones to employees.
• Ensure statutory compliance across PF, ESIC, PT, and gratuity through timely filings, audit-ready documentation, and proactive risk flagging.
• Own all employee documentation, including drafting, maintaining, and version-controlling agreements, offer letters, policies, and HR documents for accuracy and consistency.
• Manage employee benefits operations covering group health and term life insurance, including endorsements, renewals, and employee claims/query support.
 • Maintain POSH compliance by ensuring the Internal Committee is active, managing the complaints portal, and completing annual filings and case processes correctly.
• Track and implement policy updates based on labour law changes, ensuring internal policies remain current and effectively communicated to employees.
• Identify and implement automation opportunities in routine HR operations through tooling, AI-assisted workflows, and process redesign to reduce manual effort.

• End-to-end payroll management independently on Keka/equivalent tool management., including variable pay, reimbursements, TDS computation, and monthly reconciliation.
• Advanced Excel proficiency with compensation trackers, ESOP registers, and compliance dashboards using VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and nested formulas.
• Strong knowledge of statutory compliance including PF, ESIC, PT, gratuity, and labour law basics, with ability to identify issues needing legal escalation.
• Hands-on ESOP administration experience covering grant registers, vesting schedules, cliff tracking, exercise processing, and EquityList/equivalent tool management.
• Familiarity with POSH compliance, including Internal Committee setup, complaints portal management, and timely annual filings.
• Experience managing employee benefits such as group health and term life insurance, including endorsements, renewals, broker coordination, and claim support.
• Skilled in drafting and maintaining employee documentation including offer letters, employment agreements, policy documents, and HR correspondence with legal accuracy.
• Strong process orientation with proven ability to build workflows, maintain clean records, and manage high-volume deadline-driven HR operations.

• Experience working in high-growth startup environments where HR operations scaled rapidly and processes were built or restructured dynamically.
• Proactive use of AI tools to automate repetitive HR tasks, including document drafting, policy summarisation, and tracker automation

• Own, refine, and build — The foundational processes are in place, but there is significant scope to take ownership, sharpen what exists, and build new ones from scratch. You will not just be executing — you will be the one setting the direction for how People Ops runs at FamPay.

If you're the kind of person who rolls up their sleeves, influences with evidence, and wants their work to show up in a product people love — we would like to talk.

• Drive product execution: Partner with the product team to translate vision into execution using data and past learnings.

• Work with Engineering to understand constraints and build scalable systems
• Work with Design on UX, flows, and brand consistency
• Build and manage roadmaps: Prioritize based on business goals, user needs, and data insights
• Be data-driven: Analyze funnels, user behavior, and metrics to guide decisions
• Get hands dirty: Contribute across analysis, design discussions, and execution
• Influence stakeholders: Drive alignment using data and user insights
• Full-stack builder mindset: Comfortable with AI tools and shipping small features to production
• Prototype fast: Use AI tools to build, iterate, and collaborate via show-and-tell
 
Must-haves (Min. qualifications) :- 
• 2–4 years of experience in Product Management, preferably in FinTech or B2C consumer products
• Strong understanding of consumer behavior with the ability to build user-loved products
• Experience owning features or product areas end-to-end with measurable impact
• Strong analytical mindset: Comfortable using data to drive decisions and validate hypotheses
• Good understanding of product, design, and engineering collaboration
• Ability to define and track key product metrics (activation, retention, engagement, etc.)
• Strong documentation skills: Clear, structured PRDs with attention to detail
• Proven ability to prioritize and execute in fast-paced environments
 
Good to have :- 
• Experience in FinTech, Payments, or Banking products
• Familiarity with growth, activation, and retention-focused problem statements
• Exposure to experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, cohort analysis, funnel optimization)
• Hands-on experience with analytics tools like Mixpanel, Amplitude, Google Analytics, or similar
• Basic understanding of SQL or data querying for self-serve analysis
• Experience working in 0→1 or fast-scaling startup environments
• Strong understanding of consumer product patterns across leading apps (onboarding, engagement loops, etc.)
• Familiarity with AI tools for prototyping, analysis, or productivity
• Exposure to design systems and UX principles
• Experience collaborating with growth/marketing teams on campaigns and lifecycle journeys (push, email, CRM)
 
Why join us?
• Be part of a high-energy, creatively driven team shaping the future of a growing brand
• High-impact role: Your work will directly influence the experience for the next 50M+ users
• Creative freedom: Plenty of room to experiment and bring bold ideas to life
• Collaborative culture: Work with a team that values creativity, ownership, and good vibes

lists.content:

  • Build reusable infrastructure with Infrastructure as Code and Configuration as Code with clear interfaces, validation and versioning backed by safe provisioning ci/cd workflows.
  • Operate Kubernetes as the Operating system - Own the cluster lifecycle (worker plane, node groups, add-ons) . Ability to extend it with controllers, operators, and CRDs so teams consume platform capabilities as Kubernetes-native APIs.

  • Terraform or equivalent IaC with reusable, versioned modules and safe change workflows.
  • Programming ability in Python or Go to build automation that is idempotent, retry-safe, and observable.
  • CI/CD and GitOps experience - pipeline templates, release and rollback patterns, security gates.
  • Reliability practice: SLIs/SLOs, actionable alerting, on-call, and blameless post-mortems.
  • Everyday use of AI tools, with the habit of validating their output before it ships.

• Karpenter in production - consolidation, spot handling, multi-NodePool strategy.
  • Observability at scale: Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, Loki, Jaeger, OpenTelemetry, high-cardinality metrics.
  • CI/CD supply-chain security (SAST, secret detection, image scanning, artifact promotion).
  • ClickHouse Operator on kubernetes or another analytical store solutions managed at scale in production cluster.
  • PCI, RBI, SOC 2, or similar compliance-heavy environments.

About this Role:

We are looking for a Senior DBA with 5-8 years of experience running mission-critical databases across relational , NoSQL, key-value and analytical engines, in both on-premise and managed cloud (AWS) setups. You will own uptime, performance, scaling, DR and audit readiness for the data stores behind a regulated UPI/fintech platform serving millions of users. The role sits between Engineering, Data, Security and Compliance: you decide how our databases are designed, run, recovered and paid for.

lists.content:
• Uptime & Reliability: Own availability SLOs for production databases. Lead incident response and RCAs for DB-related outages, and drive fixes to closure.
  • On-call Support: Participate in the 24x7 database on-call rotation, including off-hours and weekend cover. Act as the escalation point for DB incidents raised by SRE and engineering teams, keep runbooks and alert thresholds current, and cut alert noise so pages are actionable.
  • Performance & Scaling: Profile production workloads (slow query logs, pg_stat_statements, Performance Schema, DynamoDB/Cassandra metrics) and act on them: indexing, query rewrites, partitioning, connection pooling, read replicas, sharding, capacity changes.
  • Workload Analysis & Decisions: Separate OLTP and analytical access patterns, push back on schemas or queries that will not scale, and make evidence-backed calls on engine choice, instance class and topology.
  • DR & Multi-Zone Replication: Design and test backup, PITR, cross-AZ and cross-region replication. Plan and execute periodic DR drills with documented RTO/RPO results.
  • Audit & Compliance: Own database controls for RBI, NPCI, ISO 27001, PCI DSS and third-party audits: access reviews, encryption at rest and in transit, audit logging, data retention, data localisation evidence. Be the point person for auditor walkthroughs.
  • Cost Optimisation: Right-size instances, reserved capacity and storage tiers; tune DynamoDB capacity modes; retire unused replicas and snapshots. Report spend against usage.
  • CDC Operations: Operate and tune CDC pipelines (Debezium, Kafka Connect, AWS DMS): replication slots, binlog/WAL retention, schema changes, lag and replay.
  • Object Storage & Lifecycle: Manage S3 buckets used for backups, archives and the lakehouse. Analyse access patterns and set lifecycle, tiering and retention policies.
  • Distributed Query Engines: Operate and tune MPP engines such as Trino, StarBurst, StarRocks, BigQuery: cluster sizing, resource groups, caching, query governance.
  • Design Standards: Define and enforce standards for schema design, naming, indexing, migrations, access roles and PII handling. Review schema changes before they reach production.
  • Maintenance & Security Upgrades: Own version upgrades, patching, parameter changes and certificate rotation with zero or planned-minimal downtime.
  • Launch Readiness: Prepare database infrastructure for new product rollouts: capacity plans, load tests, migration runbooks, rollback paths.
  • Collaboration: Work with backend, data, SRE, security and non-technical stakeholders (compliance, finance, product) and translate DB risk into decisions they can act on.

• 5-8 years in database administration or database reliability engineering, with at least 3 years on high-traffic, customer-facing production systems.
  • Deep production expertise in PostgreSQL or PostgresSQL Based, including replication internals, vacuum/InnoDB tuning, and upgrades on both self-managed and RDS/Aurora.
  • Production experience with at least two of: DynamoDB, Cassandra, MongoDB, Redis.
  • Proven record of DR drills, multi-AZ/multi-region replication and restoring from backup under pressure.
  • Direct involvement in regulatory or third-party audits (RBI, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC 2 or equivalent), including producing evidence and closing findings.
  • Hands-on database cost optimisation with measurable savings.
  • Strong SQL, query plan analysis and scripting in Python or Bash for automation.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform or CloudFormation) and monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog or similar).
  • Solid understanding of database security: IAM and role design, encryption, secrets management, audit logging.
  • Willingness to be part of a 24x7 on-call rotation, with prior experience handling production DB incidents off-hours.

• Operating Debezium / Kafka Connect CDC in production.
  • Running Trino,Starburst, StarRocks or BigQuery clusters at scale.
  • S3 lifecycle and storage tiering design for backups and data lakes.
  • Databases on Kubernetes (operators such as CloudNativePG, Percona, K8ssandra).
  • Experience in fintech, payments or banking, especially UPI or card systems.
  • Familiarity with Apache Iceberg / DeltaLake or Lakehouse table formats.
  • Analysing slow queries generated by BI tools such as Superset, Metabase or Power BI, tracing slow dashboard rendering back to query patterns, missing indexes or unsuitable data models, and fixing them at the source or through aggregates and caching.
  • Taking part in CI/CD for database changes: migration tooling (Flyway, Liquibase, Alembic or similar), automated schema linting and review gates that enforce design standards before changes reach production.
  • Certifications: AWS Database Specialty, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or Cassandra.

Experience: 3 to 5 years of dedicated experience in IT risk management, cybersecurity, third-party risk management (TPRM), or information security governance.

• Drive product vision and execution: Translate the broader product strategy into actionable roadmaps and deliver measurable impact
  • Own key funnels or metrics – define, monitor, and improve critical KPIs such as activation, retention, CSAT, or revenue
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, Growth, and Analytics teams to deliver end-to-end solutions
  • Identify and solve real user problems by deeply understanding user needs, identifying opportunities, validating hypotheses, and delivering delightful experiences
  • Be data-informed: Use quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize features and evaluate success post-launch
  • Ensure high-quality product documentation by writing clear, structured PRDs and contributing to improved product processes
  • Mentor and guide PMs through structured feedback, sharing best practices, and conducting product reviews
  • Influence through user advocacy: Balance business goals with user empathy and data-driven decision-making
  • Collaborate with teams to align on product priorities, share insights, and communicate progress effectively
  • Get hands dirty when needed: Participate in discovery, design reviews, QA, or data deep-dives as required

• 6–8 years of experience in Product Management, ideally in B2C or consumer-facing products
  • Proven track record of owning a key product metric (e.g., acquisition, activation, retention, revenue, NPS, CSAT, etc) and driving it end-to-end
  • Experience working closely with Design and Engineering teams to conceptualise, prioritise, and ship impactful features
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills – ability to translate data into insights and insights into product decisions
  • Hands-on experience with funnel analysis and experimentation (A/B testing)
  • Past experience in writing and reviewing PRDs and driving execution from idea to launch
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills with clarity, depth, and stakeholder alignment
  • Strong consumer understanding – ability to empathize with users and identify what drives delight vs. friction
  • Executional ownership – solving real problems and delivering measurable business outcomes
  • Actively leverages AI in day-to-day workflows and is familiar with tools beyond just GPT/Claude

• Experience in FinTech, Payments, or B2C commerce
  • Exposure to ads, revenue, or customer retention initiatives
  • Prior experience as an engineer turned PM or strong technical understanding of frontend/backend systems
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-paced environments
  • Exposure to KYC, Customer Support, Retention, and Growth verticals
  • Experience in building for scale, leveraging consumer insights and data to prioritize product bets
  • Understanding of design systems, usability principles, and user behavior analytics tools
  • Experience mentoring or managing small product pods or PMs
  • Proven ability to mentor junior PMs or cross-functional teams

• Make a significant impact on building how the next generation will interact with money
  • Take ownership of end-to-end product strategy, from vision to execution.
  • Opportunity to grow as a product leader and make a lasting impact in a high-growth environment.
